extension.description: To help Minecraft developers create resource packs more efficiently
config.title: Minecraft Resourcepack Helper
config.desc.defaultMcAssetsPath: absolute path to vanilla Minecraft assets, used for definitions, completions, and diagnostics; accepts an assets folder, assets/minecraft folder, or a resource pack root containing assets/minecraft
config.desc.resourcePackLoadOrder: absolute paths to enabled resource pack roots below the currently edited pack, ordered from higher priority to lower priority
config.desc.tipColorForUndefinedTextureV: the tip color for undefined texture variants in model files
command.title.openDefaultMcAssetsPath: McResHelper: open folder of vanilla assets
command.title.createNewResourcePack: McResHelper: create a new pack in current folder
command.title.createNewResourcePackRoot: McResHelper: create a new pack with the current folder as the root directory
command.title.openResourceGraphModelPrev: McResHelper: open model preview from resource graph
command.title.openUnsupportedModelPrevie: McResHelper: model preview unavailable for this resource
